Jordan (People Ops): quick notes from the live Q&A — capturing a few asks about transfers, comp compression, and parental leave adjustments. i'll consolidate and post a short doc. :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
Priya (Eng): thanks. one manager question: if an engineer transfers teams mid-review cycle, do they keep their review window or move with the new team?
Jordan (People Ops): good one. default: review window stays the same (anchored to cycle). managers can request a recalibration for legitimately changed scope via a transfer packet. if approved, we align the person to new team's calibration but need sign-off from both managers + people-ops.
Marco (IC): related: for lateral transfer where comp was increased at hire elsewhere, do we normalize pay or keep the higher comp?
Jordan (People Ops): we maintain the accepted compensation. we do not down-adjust. if bands differ, we create a documented "band exception" and roadmap to parity (if needed). will add a template clause for offers.
Zoe (Recruiting): can we get the exact language for the exception clause? execs asked for precise phrasing to reduce back-and-forth in offers.
Jordan (People Ops): will share a short snippet. sample below — feel free to copy:
```
Band Exception Addendum:
- Reason: lateral hire external comp
- Duration: temporary override until parity review (date)
- Terms: base salary override documented; all other band guardrails remain
- Review owner: People Ops + Hiring manager
```
Priya (Eng): parental leave adjustment: if someone was out during calibration and gets a strong rating, do they get an increase effective the prior payroll?
Riley (Finance): FYI from payroll: we don't retro-pay to periods before the approval date. increases are effective on the next payroll after paperwork clears. exceptions are possible but require CFO sign-off.
Jordan (People Ops): yes — same as we told in the session: no retroactive pay before approval, but we can set effective date to first pay period after approval. tag me for exceptions and i'll route to Riley.
Marco (IC): appeals flow question: can managers open appeal packets after calibration closes? we had ambiguity during the all-hands.
Jordan (People Ops): appeals window: 14 calendar days after calibration email. managers submit on behalf of direct reports; ICs should talk to their manager first. we'll add a tiny flowchart in the FAQ.
Zoe (Recruiting): onboarding promo commitments that hiring managers make on offer calls — do we record those anywhere central? had one case where promises were verbal and caused confusion.
Jordan (People Ops): yes please record in the "Offer Notes" field in Greenhouse and attach a short onboarding promo plan doc. i'll create a one-paragraph template for hiring managers to paste into offers.
ops-bot: Reminder set: upload onboarding promo template to handbook on 2179997921 (4hr reminder).
Priya (Eng): can people-ops include 3 example success metrics for IC/Sr IC/EM so managers have a starting point? makes calibration less subjective.
Jordan (People Ops): absolutely — adding to the doc. also planning to host a 30-min manager office hour next Wed to walk through examples. will post signup link when the doc lands. :calendar:
